thread:
Priya K: Quick sync — Q2 PLG adoption playbook & commitment targets. Proposed goals: 20% uplift in self-serve conversions, $350k net-new ARR from trial->paid in Q2. Need alignment on sales targets, launch checklist, enablement. Short take?

Ben M: Quick take — sounds doable but need clarity: is $350k net-new or includes expansion? Also want experiment cadence from marketing (how many A/Bs + timing). :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Cara S: Make it net-new. For sales to hit this we need clear handoff criteria from marketing -> sales. Current trial->demo conversion is noisy. Can we define a clean MQL -> SQL for PLG?

Mateo R: +1 on handoff. Also request a 1-pager SE playbook: qualification checklist + 2 demo scripts for PLG accounts. I can draft if someone assigns.

Alice L: From product side — we should lock the in-product triggers that drive upgrade: 1) billing prompt before quota is hit, 2) contextual in-app CTA, 3) usage milestone emails. Which are must-haves for Q2 launch vs nice-to-have?

Jordan V: Ops note — we need attribution instrumentation for trial->paid and ARR tagging. I'll own dashboard, but need event names from Eng/Product. Can we commit to naming schema by next week?

DevExBot: Heads up — Eng capacity for Q2 PLG work: 5 sprint slots reserved in sprint 12-14. Please file tickets and tag @eng-platform.

Ben M: Marketing experiments proposal: A) guided onboarding (hand-holding + checklist) vs B) email drip + self-serve docs. Hypothesis: guided onboarding + SE time -> +8-12% conversion; email drip -> cheaper. Success metric: activation rate at day 14. Need experiment owners & timeline.

Priya K: Suggest activation metric = "activated if 3 distinct inference calls AND integration configured" — simple, measurable. Agree?

Cara S: Fine. For quota planning: sellers need enablement pack (1-pager + 30-min roleplay). Also need account eligibility rules: recommend company size >100 && trial org usage > $500/mo to qualify for sales outreach.

Alice L: Legal note — trial terms changed slightly for billing prompt. Need legal sign-off before in-product prompt. Who owns legal loop?

Priya K: Action items I propose: Ben — finalize experiment plan by Mar 5; Alice — scope in-product prompts by Mar 8; Mateo — draft SE playbook by Mar 10; Jordan — dashboard & attribution by Mar 12; Cara — compile quota mapping by Mar 7; Legal approver TBD (Alice to escalate). OK? :thumbsup:

Ben M: I'll set experiment owners and calendar. Planning to run first A/B starting Mar 15. I'll drop full plan in the Notion doc.

Mateo R: I'll start SE playbook draft today. Will include 2 demo scripts + qualification checklist.

Jordan V: Will sketch dashboard event list by EOD Tue and ping Eng for event names.

Alice L: I'll loop legal and post scope in the doc. Also marking billing prompt as must-have, milestone emails as priority 2.

Cara S: I'll send seller eligibility CSV and typical conversion numbers by Mar 7. Also request 2 roleplay slots the week of Mar 14.

Priya K: Thanks everyone. I'll create the Notion playbook and tag owners: https://redwood/notion/q2-plg-playbook (placeholder link). We'll keep updates there.

Ben M: Adding marketing copy draft today. Will coordinate with growth for paid channels.

Cara S: One more ask — can we have an easy FAQ for sellers about the trial billing prompt? Quick answers help reduce confusion.

Mateo R: I'll add quick FAQ in SE playbook.

Priya K: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock these items and run a 15-min sync next Wed to check progress. :calendar:

Ben M: :thumbsup:

Cara S: :thumbsup:

Alice L: :thumbsup:

Jordan V: :thumbsup:

DevExBot: Reminder scheduled: 15-min PLG sync set for next Wed 10:00am.
